# International Journal of Business, Technology and Organizational Behavior (IJBTOB)

> An open-access academic journal publishing peer-reviewed research on business, technology, and organizational behavior with Creative Commons licensing.

IJBTOB is an international open-access journal based in Tangerang, Indonesia, dedicated to publishing original research in business, organizational behavior, and technology. The journal operates under a CC-BY-NC 4.0 license and maintains rigorous peer review standards for manuscript evaluation and publication.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
